<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/defective-computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AcceptCosts" name="Acceptance of repair costs"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RejectCosts" name="Rejection of repair costs"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_ComputerBrought" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Event_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance of repair costs" sourceRef="Event_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection of repair costs" sourceRef="Event_SendRejection" targetRef="Event_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer repair decision" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Repair needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCostCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveCostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideCosts" name="Decide whether repair costs are acceptable"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostDecision" name="Are the costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance of repair costs">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendRejection" name="Send rejection of repair costs">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerAccepts" name="Repair accepted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComputerTakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveCostCalculation" targetRef="Task_DecideCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_DecideCosts" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Event_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">costsAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Event_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not costsAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Event_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_CustomerAccepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Event_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_ComputerTakenHome"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComputerBrought" name="Defective computer brought in">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ComputerBrought" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCostCalculation" name="Prepare and hand out repair cost calculation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendCostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendCostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForCostDecision" name="Wait for customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance of repair costs">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection of repair costs">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectCosts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRSRejected" name="Repair not accepted"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialRepairOrder" name="Which repair activity first?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairChoice" name="Which repair activity?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReworkMerge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairEvaluationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Was an error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_ComputerBrought" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_PrepareCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCostCalculation" targetRef="Event_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Event_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForCostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForCostDecision" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_6" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForCostDecision" targetRef="Event_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_7" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_CRSRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_8" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_InitialRepairOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_9" name="Hardware first" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialRepairOrder" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hardwareFirst</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_10" name="Software first" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialRepairOrder" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">softwareFirst</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_11" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_12" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_13" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_14" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_InitialOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_15" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_16" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_17" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_18" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_InitialOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_19" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialOrderMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RepairEvaluationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_20" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairEvaluationMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_21" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_RepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_22" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="End_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_23" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairChoice" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hardwareRepair</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_24" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairChoice" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">softwareRepair</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_25" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_ReworkMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_26" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_ReworkMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_27" sourceRef="Gateway_ReworkMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RepairEvaluationMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
